# Coding resources

Here is a list of resources that I found useful for learning a programming language or specific applications in that language.

## R

[Beckerman et al: Getting Started with R: An Introduction for Biologists (2nd edition)](https://www.amazon.com/Getting-Started-R-Introduction-Biologists/dp/0198787847)

[Wickham et al: R for Data Science](https://www.tidyverse.org/learn/)

[Lee: Happy Belly Bioinformatics](https://astrobiomike.github.io)

[Any material by Dr. Allison Horst](https://allisonhorst.github.io)

[Intro to R for use in Marine Microbiology](https://drive.google.com/drive/u/2/folders/14lipZSQuCMKqCCCrjQbpIYEtPhch91L5): These are videos I created for a lab course at UCSB (EEMB 144L) for remote learning in 2020.

## Python

[Anbernathy: An Introduction to Earth and Environmental Data Science](https://earth-env-data-science.github.io/intro.html)

[PACE Hackweek](https://pacehackweek.github.io/pace-2024/intro.html): Resources for exploring remote sensing observations by the NASA PACE satellite using python

## MATLAB

[UMAINE MISC Lab Ocean Optics](https://github.com/OceanOptics): Code for processing or analyzing bio-optical data

# Book recommendations 

Here is a list of books relevant to science and exploration, that I found practical, fascinating, and/or uplifting.

[Letters to a Young Scientist by E.O Wilson](https://bookshop.org/p/books/letters-to-a-young-scientist-honorary-curator-in-entomology-and-university-research-professor-emeritus-edward-o-wilson/0005e49f3ada7123?ean=9780871403858&next=t)

[I Contain Multitudes by Ed Yong](https://bookshop.org/p/books/i-contain-multitudes-the-microbes-within-us-and-a-grander-view-of-life-ed-yong/12796f7554812fca?ean=9780062368607&next=t)

[Rancher, Farmer, Fisherman by Miriam Horn](https://bookshop.org/p/books/rancher-farmer-fisherman-conservation-heroes-of-the-american-heartland-miriam-horn/f83a5866cefe7c66?ean=9780393354874&next=t)

[The Wide Wide Sea: Imperial Ambition, First Contact and the Fateful Final Voyage of Captain James Cook by Hampton Sides](https://bookshop.org/p/books/rancher-farmer-fisherman-conservation-heroes-of-the-american-heartland-miriam-horn/f83a5866cefe7c66?ean=9780393354874&next=t)

[The Big Burn: Teddy Roosevelt and the Fire that Saved America by Timothy Egan](https://bookshop.org/p/books/the-big-burn-teddy-roosevelt-and-the-fire-that-saved-america/1509779?ean=9780547394602&next=t)

[Your Future on the Faculty: How to Survive and Thrive in Academia
by Joshua Schimel](https://bookshop.org/p/books/your-future-on-the-faculty-how-to-survive-and-thrive-in-academia-professor-of-ecology-evolution-and-marine-biology-joshua-schimel/253995197976f7bf?ean=9780197608838&next=t)

[Writing Science How to Write Papers That Get Cited and Proposals That Get Funded by Joshua Schimel](https://bookshop.org/p/books/writing-science-how-to-write-papers-that-get-cited-and-proposals-that-get-funded-joshua-schimel/8bfd565d9d585a16?ean=9798874728656&next=t)
